svg.title: F33-1 Quick-reference sheet 1: electrical acceptance values
svg.text: IR, 25 kV class (20 kV), 5,000 V DC
≤ 4 ms; no 0 V longer than 20 ms
What to prove on the record
1. Each IR result names the voltage class row, the test voltage and the value corrected to 20 °C.
2. Each generator step lists the minimum frequency in Hz and voltage in kV against 46.5 Hz and 17.0 kV.
3. Each STS and UPS transfer record attaches the waveform and the ITI or class 1 curve overlay.
F33-1 Quick-reference sheet 1: electrical acceptance values
MV IR 10,000 MΩ at 5,000 V DC for the 25 kV class · TTR ±0.5 % · VLF 26 kV for 30 min · Type 10 bus live ≤ 10 s · G3 dip ≤ 7 % and ≤ 15 % · UPS autonomy ≥ 5 min · STS ≤ 4 ms
• The 20 kV switchgear IR minimum is 10,000 MΩ at 5,000 V DC from the 25 kV class row of ATS-2021, marked confirm against ATS-2025.
• Generator load steps pass at a frequency dip of 7 % or less (46.5 Hz) and a voltage dip of 15 % or less (17.0 kV) with recovery in 3 s and 4 s.
